svg.title: Admin UI SDK architecture with Developer Console publishing and v1/v2 extension points
svg.desc: Apps are deployed in the Adobe Developer Console and published to the App Registry. Adobe Commerce authenticates via IMS and fetches extension registrations from the App Registry through commerce/backend-ui/2 (enforces ACL, supports App Management extensions) or the deprecated commerce/backend-ui/1 (no ACL, still supported). Registrations are saved to the Commerce database and rendered in the Admin UI.
